name: research_digest
description: Collects RSS/Atom feeds and public Telegram channel pages into a deduplicated AI/ML/business research digest.
when_to_use: User wants to monitor AI, engineering, ML adoption, agentic systems, business implementation cases, research papers, or prepare a Telegram-channel news digest.

scheduled_tasks.name: daily_ai_research_digest
scheduled_tasks.description: At 14:00 Moscow time, refresh configured RSS and public Telegram AI/Research sources, then build a weekly digest with exactly 6 highest-scoring items using research_digest.refresh(limit_per_source=30) and research_digest.digest(hours=168, limit=6, min_score=1). Return Telegram-ready markdown and mention source errors, if any.

components.idle: Refresh configured RSS/Atom and public Telegram sources.
